name: Lonesome harmonica calls
desc: Sparse plaintive chromatic-harmonica phrases in E major, calling and falling silent across the drone, a dub delay answering each figure while the phrases lengthen from single cries at sparse to breathing melodic runs at peak.

cut.doc: lpf center Hz — the swell orbits around this

code.full: note("<[e5 ~ b4 g#4] [g#5 ~ f#5 e5] [b4 c#5 b4 g#4] [f#5 e5 ~ b4]>").add(note(${root})).s("super64_vib").attack(.05).release(.5).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.4).slow(24)).lpq(1).off(1/4, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.3)).delay(".5:.375:.45").pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(20)).gain(sine.range(${gain}*.75,${gain}).slow(16)).room(${room}).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[e5 f#5 g#5 b5] [c#6 b5 g#5 f#5] [b5 c#6 b5 e5] [g#5 f#5 e5 b4]>").add(note(${root})).s("super64_vib").attack(.04).release(.5).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.7).slow(16)).lpq(1).iter(4).off(1/4, x=>x.add(note(7)).gain(.35)).delay(".5:.1875:.5").pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(18)).gain(sine.range(${gain}*.8,${gain}).slow(12)).room(${room}).orbit(5).play()
